    • function: Childcare & Infant Support

    job_description

    We are looking for a caring and responsible full-time nanny to provide daily care for a 4-year-old child. Responsibilities include preparing the child for the day, school drop-off and pick-up, accompanying the child to activities and appointments, supporting learning through age-appropriate educational activities, and ensuring a safe, nurturing, and engaging environment. The ideal candidate has a background in education, early childhood development, or a related field, previous experience caring for young children, excellent communication skills, and a valid driver's license. Applicants should be reliable, organized, patient, and passionate about supporting a child's development and well-being.
